ffn_only_combine_grid_scratch.native_source_sha256: 0f44a3c1 (final 9675783b + b31-patch.py host switch AFDEP_SCRATCH_FFN_COMBINE_SMS; arms other than base run AFDEP_GRID_SYNC_EXIT=1 so the Attention counts one arrival per FFN)
ffn_only_combine_grid_scratch.patch:
"""b31-patch.py <tree>: scratch FFN-only combine grid (AFDEP_SCRATCH_FFN_COMBINE_SMS), grid-sync exit only. Measurement, not for commit."""
import sys
from pathlib import Path
p = Path(sys.argv[1]) / "afdep/third_party/deepep_v2/csrc/elastic/buffer.hpp"
s = p.read_text()
old = """            num_sms, jit::device_runtime->get_num_smem_bytes(),
            num_channels,
            use_expanded_layout, allow_multiple_reduction,
            comm_stream,"""
new = """            (afd_direct and afd_worker and not afdep_per_cta_exit() and get_env<int>("AFDEP_SCRATCH_FFN_COMBINE_SMS") > 0) ?
                get_env<int>("AFDEP_SCRATCH_FFN_COMBINE_SMS") : num_sms,
            jit::device_runtime->get_num_smem_bytes(),
            num_channels,
            use_expanded_layout, allow_multiple_reduction,
            comm_stream,"""
assert s.count(old) == 1, s.count(old)
p.write_text(s.replace(old, new))
print("patched", p)

"""b31b-patch.py <tree>: scratch combine-only SM count (AFDEP_SCRATCH_COMBINE_SMS) for every role and Masked. Measurement only."""
import sys
from pathlib import Path
p = Path(sys.argv[1]) / "afdep/deepep.py"

            handle.num_sms,

            self._num_qps(int(os.environ.get("AFDEP_SCRATCH_COMBINE_SMS", "0")) or handle.num_sms),

print("patched", p)

streaming_expand_timing_bound.native_source_sha256: 073ced76 (final + b31e-patch.py: copy epilogue without its whole-dispatch dependency, fence before the FFN receive's count trigger); WRONG DATA by design, timing only
streaming_expand_timing_bound.patch:
"""b31e-patch.py <tree>: TIMING BOUND ONLY (wrong data): the copy epilogue skips its whole-dispatch dependency and starts at the
FFN receive's count trigger, so expansion overlaps ingress. Measurement of the overlap ceiling for a 3:1 streaming expand; never commit."""
import sys
from pathlib import Path
impls = Path(sys.argv[1]) / "afdep/third_party/deepep_v2/deep_ep/include/deep_ep/impls"
p = impls / "dispatch_copy_epilogue.cuh"; s = p.read_text()
old = "    cudaGridDependencySynchronize();\n"
assert s.count(old) == 1
s = s.replace(old, "    // b31e timing bound: no whole-dispatch dependency\n"); p.write_text(s)
p = impls / "afdep_ffn_dispatch.cuh"; s = p.read_text()
old = "    if (warp_idx < kNumNotifyWarps) cudaTriggerProgrammaticLaunchCompletion();"
assert s.count(old) == 1
s = s.replace(old, "    if (warp_idx < kNumNotifyWarps) { __threadfence(); cudaTriggerProgrammaticLaunchCompletion(); }"); p.write_text(s)
print("patched", impls)
streaming_expand_timing_bound.note_2a2f: the 2A2F bound arm failed benchmarks.comm's correctness check (expected for a wrong-data bound); no 2A2F numbers
streaming_expand_timing_bound.count_arrival_from_kernel_timelines: epilogue start minus FFN receive start under the count trigger: 7.2, 11.4, 25 and 73 us at 1, 128, 512, 2048 tokens (3A:1F traces above)

count_first_standin_timing_bound.native_source_sha256: cfc0d694 (b31e tree + b31f-patch.py 3000 ns) and its 8000 ns twin; benchmarks.comm check disabled in both trees (data wrong by design); final arm = /work/src-fin4 (9675783b)
count_first_standin_timing_bound.patch:
"""b31f-patch.py <tree> <delay_ns>: TIMING BOUND ONLY, on top of b31e: source payload warps idle <delay_ns> at entry so the count
stores reach the FFN before the payload. Tests whether count-first ordering lets the expansion overlap ingress; never commit."""
import sys
from pathlib import Path
p = Path(sys.argv[1]) / "afdep/third_party/deepep_v2/deep_ep/include/deep_ep/impls/dispatch.cuh"
s = p.read_text()
old = "        const int dispatch_warp_idx = warp_idx - kNumNotifyWarps;\n"
assert s.count(old) == 1
new = old + (f"        if (afd_source) {{ unsigned long long t0, t1; asm volatile(\"mov.u64 %0, %%globaltimer;\" : \"=l\"(t0));"
             f" do {{ asm volatile(\"mov.u64 %0, %%globaltimer;\" : \"=l\"(t1)); }} while (t1 - t0 < {int(sys.argv[2])}ull); }}  // b31f\n")
p.write_text(s.replace(old, new))
print("patched", p, sys.argv[2])
